name: Canara Robeco Asset Management Company Ltd
title: Canara Robeco Asset Management Company Ltd - 544580 - Transcript Of Earnings Call - Q4 & FY2026 - Audited Financial Results

read.thesis: Asset manager with 91% equity AUM; FY26 revenue up 17% to INR424.9 crore but SIP flows and AUM softer on mark-to-market, with no capacity or supply metrics applicable, and cost guidance vague.

triggers.label: SIP flows declining three quarters
triggers.quote: SIP flows have been going down every quarter for the last three quarters

triggers.label: Yield 35 bps FY26, 39 bps Q4
triggers.quote: our equity AUM contributed yield was about 37 bps, fixed income was about 30 bps

triggers.label: TER to BER shift: neutral to +2 bps
triggers.quote: At worst, we will be neutral on this, at best we probably may gain a couple of basis points

guidance.quote: We like it to be between 40% and 50%. That's the range we look at.
For us, we are comfortable with yields being in the range of 32 to 40.

guidance.value: Another NFO in next four to five months; about two funds a year
guidance.quote: We typically try and do about two funds a year, and that should be the par for the course even for this financial year.

red_flags.label: SIP book and AUM declining for three quarters
red_flags.quote: SIP flows have been going down every quarter for the last three quarters

red_flags.label: One-off costs inflating Q4 other expenses
red_flags.quote: There is a one-time expenses included, because we have a NFO in the last quarter

evasions.quote: we were in line , or better than the industry when it comes to the flows, but would not be able to spell out the number
it will be a forward -looking statement
I think it's best to wait for the next quarter numbers
